searchText: Hi! I'm taking the notes for the latest ACD call, and there's a name I can't make out - I think it's the testing tool Rai and Martin are working on? It comes up a few times in the conversation about YOLOv3. Rai mentions it about 7 seconds after this timemark: https://youtu.be/3xNfGNnQ5Vs?t=300 Can someone please tell me what it is? It's the only thing stopping me from PRing the notes. Thanks! Retesteth 👍 https://github.com/ethereum/retesteth And another related tool to retesteth which is called t8ntool: https://github.com/ethereum/tests/blob/develop/docs/t8ntool-ref.rst <@!601063305070772244> This is the one I was looking for! Thanks, and to you too <@!187490121698770945> . I kept on thinking it was something like "tea and ate tool". I would have happily accepted that as the transcription text. 😀
